title: Four equivalent characterisations of an etale morphism, by local and affine-local conditions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent ways to say that a morphism is etale: directly; by requiring every ring map between the rings of an affine open pair to be etale; by the existence of an open covering of the base with open coverings of the preimages on which the restrictions are etale; and the same with affine coverings and the corresponding ring maps etale, and it adds that the restriction of an etale morphism to open subschemes is etale. The proof feeds the property into the general lemma that converts a local property of ring maps into the equivalent morphism-level characterisations, which requires checking the three conditions of the definition of a local property, and it states that those three conditions all follow from the algebra lemma on etale ring maps.
